name: System diary
description: A one-bit window with a pinstriped title bar and a hard drop shadow holds an open diary; one page is checkerboard grey and an arrow pointer reaches in.
choices: Desktop-era one-bit rules: pinstripe title bar, close box, hard shadow and dithered grey, aligned to whole pixels
Black and white become brand navy and warm paper; a tan ribbon is the only extra colour
motion: The pointer nudges toward the diary every five seconds.
typography: DejaVu Sans Bold, plain outlined wordmark
